key_terms.حَتْفَ أَنْفِهِ: a natural death; an idiomatic expression for dying in one's ordinary course without being killed

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase "أَمَاتَ حَتْفَ أَنْفِهِ" mean in hadith?
ai.summary: This concise prophetic statement describes someone as having died a natural death. In the cited context, it is used regarding a person who died without participating in active jihad.
